subtitle: Cross-check of 03/Oct/2026, the eve of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, the seven national polls released on 03/Oct, Datafolha BR-01708/2026, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) BR-02197/2026, PoderData BR-03519/2026, CNT/MDA BR-04756/2026, Palver BR-00198/2026, Gerp BR-00509/2026 and Futura/100% Cidades BR-02431/2026, and the press flow of 02 and 03/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 35.50% (vol USD 14.46M cumulative) in the winner contract, down 7.00pp raw and 6.91pp normalized, confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 17.30pp, to 41.00% (vol USD 1.46M). POLL: he leads the first round in four of the seven national polls of 03/Oct and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in two; in Palver, the chart's benchmark, he has 43% and 44%.
fortes: Leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the seven national polls of 03/Oct: 42% to 40% in Datafolha, 40% to 38% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 42% to 41% in PoderData and 43.1% to 38% in CNT/MDA.

Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, 47% to 46%, and in CNT/MDA, 47.3% to 43.1%, and ties at 46% in PoderData. In Palver he beats Augusto Cury by 44% to 36% and Renan Santos by 44% to 33%.
In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 17.30pp, to 41.00%.
fracos: Falls 7.00pp in the winner contract, to 35.50%, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula widens from 15.25pp to 29.05pp.
In the series recorded since April 14 his price is 1.00pp from the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

Trails in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the seven national polls of 03/Oct: Palver and Gerp, 44% to 49%, Futura, 45.1% to 48%, and [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 42% to 44%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval falls from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula fell 7.00pp in the winner contract, to 35.50% (vol USD 14.46M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, and 6.91pp normalized, because the pair's sum went from 100.25 to 100.05; with that Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula widens from 15.25pp to 29.05pp, and his price is 1.00pp from the recorded low of the series. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 17.30pp, to 41.00%. 🗳️ In the seven national polls of 03/Oct he leads the first round in four and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in two, and Palver, which is the chart's benchmark, puts him 4 points behind in the first round and 5 in the second. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 64.55% (vol USD 14.08M cumulative) in the winner contract, up 6.80pp raw and 6.91pp normalized, confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 18.00pp, to 58.50% (vol USD 1.75M). POLL: 47% in the first round and 49% in the second in Palver of 03/Oct; he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the day's seven national polls.
fortes: Rises 6.80pp in the winner contract, to 64.55%, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula widens from 15.25pp to 29.05pp. The price stands 1.25pp above the recorded top of the series, 63.30% on 01/Oct.

Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the seven national polls of 03/Oct: 49% to 44% in Palver and Gerp, 48% to 45.1% in Futura and 44% to 42% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest).

In the seven national polls of 03/Oct his [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) number is higher than in the same pollster's previous round, and he leads the first round in Palver, Gerp and Futura.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
fracos: In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 18.00pp, to 58.50%: the market pays less for the chance that he finishes the first round in second place.

Trails in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the seven national polls of 03/Oct, with the largest margin in CNT/MDA, 38% to 43.1%, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha and CNT/MDA.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 6.80pp in the winner contract, to 64.55% (vol USD 14.08M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, and 6.91pp normalized. With that Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula widens from 15.25pp to 29.05pp, and his price stands 1.25pp above the recorded top of the series, 63.30% on 01/Oct. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 18.00pp, to 58.50%. 🗳️ In the seven national polls of 03/Oct he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four and the first round in three, among them Palver, which is the chart's benchmark, and in all seven his first-round number is higher than in the same pollster's previous round. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury

candidates.analise: Augusto Cury fell 3.80pp raw in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 23.50% (vol USD 0.38M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, and 3.67pp normalized, and was overtaken by Ronaldo Caiado, who stands at 25.00%. candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 25.00% (vol USD 0.23M cumulative) in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), up 13.50pp raw and 13.23pp normalized, and Romeu Zema at 0.35%, in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT. Fernando Haddad remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%. POLL: Caiado has 4% in Datafolha of 03/Oct, in third place, and Zema from 0.8% to 1% in the national polls that score him.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT. The national polls of 03/Oct test Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), and Palver puts them against Lula in second-round pairings.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.81M cumulative. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE contract he rises to 25.00%, in a USD 0.23M book. In the national polls of 03/Oct he ranges from 1% to 4%.
caiado.fortes: Rises 13.50pp in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and overtakes Augusto Cury. He is third in the first round in Datafolha of 03/Oct, with 4%, and in Palver he loses to Lula in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by only 1 point, 42% to 43%.
caiado.fracos: Has 1% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of Palver of 03/Oct and 2% in PoderData. In the third-place book he is 27.50pp behind Renan Santos.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, at the book's floor, with USD 7.74M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and none of the national polls of 03/Oct tests him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.73M cumulative. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE contract he is at 0.35%. In the national polls of 03/Oct that score him he has 0.8% to 1%.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured. In Palver of 03/Oct he loses to Lula in the second round by 42% to 44%.
zema.fracos: Remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, and is at 0.35% in the third-place book. In Palver of 03/Oct he is below 1% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

candidates.analise: Ronaldo Caiado rose 13.50pp in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), to 25.00% (vol USD 0.23M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, and 13.23pp normalized, and overtook Augusto Cury in that book. Romeu Zema is at 0.35%. 🗳️ In Datafolha of 03/Oct Caiado is third, with 4%, and in Palver he loses to Lula in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 42% to 43%; Zema loses there by 42% to 44%. fracos: Romeu Zema is at 0.35% in the third-place book and is below 1% in Palver of 03/Oct.
Fernando Haddad is not tested by any of the national polls of 03/Oct in a presidential scenario and remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, with USD 7.74M cumulative.

cruzamento: On the eve of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the winner contract's gap nearly doubles, and the day's seven national polls split. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 03/Oct, 20:23 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 6.80pp, to 64.55%, and Lula falls 7.00pp, to 35.50%, with 6.91pp for each side normalized, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula widens from 15.25pp to 29.05pp. Flávio Bolsonaro stands 1.25pp above the recorded top of the series, 63.30% on 01/Oct, and Lula 1.00pp from the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr. 🗳️ In the seven national polls released on 03/Oct, the eve of the first round, Lula leads the first round in four (Datafolha, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), PoderData and CNT/MDA) and Flávio Bolsonaro in three (Palver, Gerp and Futura); in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) Flávio Bolsonaro leads in four (Palver, Gerp, Futura and Quaest), Lula in two (Datafolha and CNT/MDA) and PoderData shows a tie at 46%. In all seven, Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round number is higher than in the same pollster's previous round: from 38% to 40% in Datafolha, from 34% to 38% in Quaest and from 44% to 47% in Palver, for example. 🥈 In the second-place book of the first round Flávio Bolsonaro's price falls 18.00pp, to 58.50%, and Lula's rises 17.30pp, to 41.00%. 🥉 In the third-place book Renan Santos remains ahead, 52.50%, and Ronaldo Caiado overtakes Augusto Cury. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price movement to polls or to acts: it measures both sides with each one's timestamps.
